      @RequestMapping(method=PUT, value="/api/users", produces="application/json", consumes="application/json") @ResponseStatus(OK) reactor.core.publisher.Mono<DomainUser> addUser(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid reactor.core.publisher.Mono<DomainUser> domainUser, @Valid @RequestParam(value="pwd",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String pwd, @Valid @RequestParam(value="ou",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String ou, @Valid @RequestParam(value="username-as-cn",required=false) @Nullable @Valid Boolean usernameAsCn, @Valid @RequestParam(value="invitation-email",required=false,defaultValue="false") @Valid Boolean invitationEmail)
      PUT /api/users Add user.
      Parameters:
      domainUser - (required)
      pwd - The password of the user. (optional)
      ou - Add user to organizational unit (like 'CN=Users'). (optional)
      usernameAsCn - Specifies whether the username should be used as common name or not. (optional)
      invitationEmail - Specifies whether an invitation email should be sent or not. (optional, default to false)
      Returns:
      OK (status code 200) or Bad request (status code 400) or Unauthorized (status code 401) or Forbidden (status code 403) or Not found (status code 404) or Already exists (status code 409) or Internal server error (status code 500)

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/api/users", produces="application/json") @ResponseStatus(OK) reactor.core.publisher.Mono<DomainUserPage> getUsers(@Valid @RequestParam(value="q",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String q, @Valid @RequestParam(value="ou",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String ou, @Valid @RequestParam(value="scope",required=false) @Nullable @Valid TreeSearchScope scope, @Valid @RequestParam(value="page",required=false,defaultValue="0") @Valid Integer page, @Valid @RequestParam(value="size",required=false,defaultValue="20") @Valid Integer size, @RequestParam(value="sort",required=false) @Nullable List<String> sort)
      GET /api/users Get user page.
      Parameters:
      q - A search term. (optional)
      ou - The search base (organizational unit) like 'CN=Users'. (optional)
      scope - The search scope (one-level|subtree). (optional)
      page - Zero-based page index (0..N) (optional, default to 0)
      size - The size of the page to be returned (optional, default to 20)
      sort - Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported. (optional)
      Returns:
      OK (status code 200) or Bad request (status code 400) or Unauthorized (status code 401) or Forbidden (status code 403) or Internal server error (status code 500)
